_readme: Crew roster = the departments of the Rovi Here operation. status: active | standby | offline.
note: The Blue Mold runs on one observer, one raven, and a crew of AI drones. Every transmission is approved by the captain before it leaves the ship.

crew.name: Rovi Here
crew.desc: Grey observer from Sector Andromeda. Roughly 50 cycles in Earth orbit. Sets the course, signs every file.

crew.name: Shadow
crew.desc: Cybernetic raven. Glowing blue optics, metallic feathers, opinions. Sits on the captain's right shoulder.

crew.name: YouTube Drone
crew.desc: Produces Rovi on Earth Files and the Blue Mold music line.

crew.name: X Drone
crew.desc: Rovi's voice on X: field reports and cold commentary.

crew.name: TikTok Drone
crew.desc: Short-form transmissions and TikTok Shop scouting.

crew.name: Ideas Lab
crew.desc: Scans for new routes: books, merch, support channels.

crew.name: Tech & Studio
crew.desc: Avatars, banners, visuals, and this bridge.
